description: This file is a shell script containing tests for a Git-related functionality, specifically focusing on the reverse index feature of Git pack files. It includes setup procedures, various test cases, and checks related to the indexing and verification of reverse index files used by Git for pack objects.

methods.name: test_index_pack
methods.description: A helper function to test the git index-pack command with different configurations, removing previous index and reverse index files, then executing index-pack and checking for the presence or absence of the reverse index file.

methods.name: corrupt_rev_and_verify
methods.description: A function to intentionally corrupt the reverse index file at a given position with a specified value, then verify that git fsck detects the corruption.
